title: Inventory Valuation Methods: FIFO, Weighted Average and Profit
scopeBoundary: Owns the inventory cost-flow and valuation decision, not stock movement controls or the general cost-of-goods-sold formula. US and IFRS boundaries are stated separately.

title: Recruitment Strategies for Small Business: Cost and Hiring Quality
scopeBoundary: Owns role definition, recruitment channels, consistent selection and onboarding measurement; complements rather than duplicates the cost-per-hire and employee-cost calculators.

title: Business Loans: Compare Types, Total Cost and Cash-Flow Fit
scopeBoundary: Parent guide for business borrowing structures and comparable cash costs; startup readiness, invoice funding and short-cycle working-capital use have separate owners.

title: Startup Business Loans: Calculate the Gap Before Applying
scopeBoundary: Owns pre-opening and early-stage funding readiness, launch cash gaps and supporting evidence; loan structures and mature working-capital cycles remain separate guides.

title: Small-Business Grants: Eligibility, Research and Cash Timing
scopeBoundary: Owns grant discovery, eligibility screening, application evidence and award-cash timing; it is not a current best-grant list, grant-writing service or loan-approval page.

title: Invoice Financing vs Factoring: Fees, Reserves and Cash Timing
scopeBoundary: Owns invoice-backed funding structure, advance/reserve reconciliation, fee basis and recourse; ordinary AR collection workflow and working-capital need have separate owners.

title: Working-Capital Loans: Size the Gap and Test Repayment
scopeBoundary: Owns short-cycle funding need and repayment against dated operating cash; separate from the working-capital balance-sheet formula, startup launch gap and invoice contract mechanics.

title: Payroll for Small Business: Reconcile Wages, Liabilities and Cash
scopeBoundary: Owns the payroll record-to-payment workflow and wage/liability reconciliation; total reward design, recruitment strategy and employer-cost pricing remain separate owners.

title: Employee Compensation: Salary, Benefits and Full Business Cost
scopeBoundary: Owns compensation-package design and recurring-versus-first-year employer-cost boundaries; separate from payroll processing, recruiting cost metrics and a compensation benchmark survey.
